newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.47 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of the 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.47 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with the six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate (HIBOR) of 6.14904 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.36 percent at the last tender on April 8.
Bids for the HK$1 billion issue eased to HK$3.22 billion from HK$3.79 billion at the previous tender.

The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.30 percent. This compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.93269 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.28 percent at last week's tender.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue was HK$6.90 billion, versus HK$4.25 billion at the previous tender, the HKMA said.
